title: [Bookgolas Web Parity 13] Reproduce onboarding and age-policy persistence
declared_commit: feat(onboarding): add localized first-run and age policy flow

red.scenario: The exact onboarding acceptance command fails before the contract exists.
red.observable: Exit 1 with npm error Missing script: test:onboarding.

criteria.scenario: Authenticated Korean and English users see all three native-aligned pages, can use next/start or skip, choose an age policy, and return to the localized consumer home.
criteria.observable: Exit 0 with 4 passed; both locales cover page 1, page 2, page 3, progress indicators, start and skip age-policy entry, stored completion and age choice, reload persistence, and localized home handoff.

criteria.scenario: Corrupt local completion and age-policy values are cleared so an authenticated user can restart onboarding and complete it.
criteria.observable: Exit 0 with 1 passed; invalid local values are removed, the first page is visible, and the flow can be completed afterward.

criteria.scenario: Anonymous onboarding uses a localized safe authentication handoff and does not bypass the authenticated consumer boundary.
criteria.observable: Exit 0; the anonymous case redirects to `/ko/auth/sign-in?returnTo=%2Fko%2Fonboarding`, and the authenticated case renders the first onboarding page.

criteria.scenario: The machine-checkable contract and negative fixture cover native-compatible keys, three pages, both locales, resettable persistence, and unsafe handoff values.
criteria.observable: Exit 0; onboarding contract PASS, onboarding state tests 3/3 and existing path tests 27/27 pass.

green.observable: Exit 0; contract PASS, 2 Vitest files and 30 tests passed.

verification.invocation: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build; npm run test:auth-boundary && npm run test:auth-email && npm run test:auth-oauth
verification.observable: TypeScript, ESLint, 22 Vitest files and 174 tests, parity matrix and 59 negative fixtures, BLDS/UI contracts, auth boundary 23 tests, auth email 35 tests, OAuth 12 tests, and the Next production build all pass.

surface.observable: Fresh Chromium captures at 390x844 cover Korean dark and English light onboarding pages, page indicators, skip/start age-policy entry, stored completion, corrupt-storage recovery, and anonymous auth handoff.

review.observable: Manual review approved the issue-scoped implementation, native alignment, localized states, protected handoff, keyboard age-policy activation, and unchanged admin/legal/marketing/native-only boundaries.

cleanup.observable: Ports 3000 and 54329 have no listeners, no task-local Next/Playwright/onboarding/fixture process remains, task-13 evidence logs contain no terminal control bytes, and the staged diff passes git diff --cached --check.
